step1.subtitle: Autonomous Trading
step1.riskBadge: HIGH RISK · YOU CAN LOSE FUNDS
step1.bodyPart1: AutonoMonke creates a separate hot wallet, watches Solana memecoins, and opens trades automatically when its TA + AI signals align. Stops and profit targets are set on every entry.
step1.bodyPart2: Profits above your max wallet balance auto-sweep back to your main wallet.
step1.seekerText: every AutonoMonke trade counts toward your SKR Activity Tracker points.
step1.ack1: I understand I may lose any or all funds I deposit into the hot wallet.
step1.ack2: I am solely responsible for funding, configuring, and monitoring this service.

step2.title: Funding Currency
step2.hint: Pick SOL or SKR. Every trade, chart, and TA mark uses this quote — buy and sell back into the same token. SKR cuts profit fees in half.
step2.skrSub: Preferred. Community token — 50% off fees on winning trades.
step2.solSub: Solana's native token — most liquid pair across memecoins.
step2.helperTextPart1: Switch the funding token any time with
step2.helperTextPart2: in the bot DM. Currently-open positions keep their original base until close.

step3.title: Per-Trade Size
step3.hint: How much {{baseCurrency}} the bot spends on every entry. Each trade is independent — smaller = more diversification, bigger = bigger swings per trade.
step3.helperText: 0.10 {{baseCurrency}} — enough room to take meaningful gains while keeping any single trade well-bounded.

step4.title: Risk Profile
step4.hint: Two settings — how much SOL the hot wallet holds, and how picky the bot is about which trades to take.
step4.maxWalletHelp: Profits above this auto-sweep to your main wallet. The hot wallet stays small.
step4.exceedsCap: Per-trade ({{perTrade}}) exceeds max ({{max}}). Bump max or go back and lower per-trade.
step4.confStrict: Strict. Only the strongest signals fire — may go days without trading.

step5.title: Review & Activate
step5.hint: After activation, the bot DMs you a hot wallet address. Fund it with {{baseCurrency}} — the bot starts trading once balance crosses the per-trade threshold.
step5.notice: You can change all of these later via DM commands or by re-running this wizard. Pause / withdraw / close-all are always one DM away.

adDisclosure.title: 🍌 About OnlyMonkes ads
adDisclosure.body1: Every once in a while (at most every couple hours, only when you reopen the app fresh), you'll see a short automatic ad — no tap required to start it.
adDisclosure.body2: Ad revenue gets swapped into $SKR, staked, and used to pay OnlyMonkes' server and API costs — the rest builds a standing $SKR Vault. Eventually that Vault also funds community giveaways and buying Saga Monkes to add to it. Never sold or used for anything else.
adDisclosure.body3: Genesis Token holders see a slightly longer ad than Saga Monke holders. You can always skip the automatic ad the moment it's closeable, same as any standard ad.
